notes: Source: Miami Dolphins 2026 Media Guide (IA item miami-dolphins-2026-media-guide, 678 pages). PDF page = printed page + 2 (for example PDF p254 is printed page 252). Pages used: DOLPHINS INDIVIDUAL RECORDS pp. 229-243 (top-5 lists per category with Career / Season / Game sub-lists), ALL-TIME LEADERS pp. 254-277 (per-category career tables), TOP 20 SEASON LEADERS pp. 278-279. The Outstanding Performances lists (pp. 280-288) and the playoff and opponent sections were not used. Every digit was checked on 220-300 dpi crops.

through_season 2025: the lists include 2025 entries (Tagovailoa 2020-25, De'Von Achane 2025 1,350 rushing yards, Jordyn Brooks 2025 183 tackles, a TD-pass game dated 10/26/25) and this is the 2026 edition (IA date 2026-09-09).

Regular season only: the Individual Records header says the lists 'include National Football League regular-season statistics only, with the exception of those single-game records marked by * (playoff game) or ** (Super Bowl)'. Starred game rows were left out and the ranks of the remaining rows are positions among them: rush_yds game (*209 Lamar Smith, 12/30/00 vs. Indianapolis), rush_td game (*3 Larry Csonka, 12/30/73 vs. Oakland), int game (*3 A.J. Duhe, 1/23/83 vs. N.Y. Jets). Other starred rows exist only in lists not used.

List choice: career pass_yds, rush_yds, rec, rec_yds, sacks and int come from the ALL-TIME LEADERS tables (top 10 copied; the sacks table has only 10 rows); season pass_yds, pass_td, rush_yds, rec, rec_yds, sacks, int and tackles come from the TOP 20 SEASON LEADERS tables; everything else comes from the Individual Records lists. Wherever a leaders table and an Individual Records list rank the same stat, the numbers were compared and agree.

Ranks: Individual Records lists print no rank numbers, so rank = printed position with tied values sharing the lowest rank (tie=true on every tied row). The leaders and Top 20 tables print rank numbers only on the first row of a tied group; the unnumbered rows below it carry the same rank and tie=true, and their raw has no rank prefix.

Sacks: career sacks come from the p277 ALL-TIME LEADERS table (10 rows; it shows Vern Den Herder at 64.0) while the p241 Individual Records list prints him at 65.0 with the same top 4; the guide disagrees with itself, so the row is marked uncertain=true and the 64.0 of the leaders table was copied. No sack list carries a 'since 1982' qualifier but all include pre-1982 players and games (Stanfill, Den Herder, Mel Branch 1968); p583 says sacks became an official NFL statistic in 1982, so sacks before 1982 are unofficial.
Tackles: only the season Top 20 (heading 'TACKLES', total tackles: the year-by-year table on p436 shows solo + assisted = total) exists; career and game tackles are missing.

Small guide inconsistencies (copied as printed): O.J. McDuffie is 1993-00 on p236 and 1993-01 on pp. 259 and 264; the two 119-reception Tyreek Hill seasons are listed 2023 then 2022 on p236 and 2022 then 2023 on p278; De'Von is printed with a typographic apostrophe (written as ' here).

Aggregate lines such as '4  27 times (last - Tua Tagovailoa, 10/26/25 at Atlanta)' in the TD-pass game list are not player rows and were not copied. Names: positional tags such as (TE) or (RB) are dropped from name (kept in raw); game 'years' hold the date as M/D/YYYY (two-digit printed years expanded) plus the printed opponent text.
